page.layout: One block of text, centred near the top: four numbered theses (XI, XII, XIII, XIV), each with its statement below it. Below them a woodcut floral ornament. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed on this page.

l.i: Mundus non potuit priùs creari, quàm creatus est.
Nullus potest incedere per planum nisi ascendendo aut des-cendendo.
Optimus Ethicus potest esse vir pessimus.
Omnis malus est ignorans, & solus ignorans est malus.
